def find_clusters(grid, target_val):
    visited = set()
    clusters = []
    for i in range(len(grid)):
        for j in range(len(grid[0])):
            if grid[i][j] == target_val and (i,j) not in visited:

                stack = [(i,j)]

                    ci, cj = stack.pop()
                    if (ci,cj) in visited:

                    visited.add((ci,cj))
                    cluster.append((ci,cj))
                    # Check neighbors

                        if 0 <= ni < len(grid) and 0 <= nj < len(grid[0]):
